integrity: A complete analytic proof and a runnable standard-library finite-field numerical cross-check are included. Same-model scientific checks only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Full classification of nonsymmetric optimal measures is not asserted.
Concurrent linear pencils only, 2<=k<=q; k=q+1 has trivial uniform zero bias.
Nonnegative probability weights; signed or complex measures not included.
An undiscovered equivalent exact minimax formula may exist; published and indexed checks are not exhaustive.
title: Sharp Fourier-bias balancing on incomplete finite-field line pencils
